errors.evidence: The description fails to mention that all three lines use circle markers, which was requested by the prompt ('Markierungsform').
The description does not specify the line style for any of the three lines (e.g., solid), as requested by the prompt ('Linienstil (z. B. durchgezogen, gestrichelt)').
The dark blue line (Maximum) at x=0.3 has a y-value of approximately 4,500 MW, not 4,000 MW as stated.
The phrasing 'steigt auf' (rises to) is inaccurate and confusing, as the line remains flat at a value of 0 between x=0 and x=0.2. It does not 'rise' to this point.
